original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected reproduction command and choose a single replay stage for profiling.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Can the historical inplace-side prefix checker (scripts/experiments/inplace_side.py:verify_prefix on the three pinned h=42/46/50 witnesses) be sped up without changing any receipt field, rejection condition or the regenerated certificates/inplace-side.json except its single source pin?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. The OS-random bit-mechanisms draw (seed 1cd1f71746c2d200dd617bc3dd17d8a6) was saturated on helper-contract/register-model work; expertise override selected verifier-engineering. Profiling make verify-certificates pointed at this fixed historical screen rather than isolated-test harness caching.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: the inplace-side certificate is part of verify-certificates. A faster identical replay does not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving verify_prefix change with frozen baseline, identical witness receipts, rejection/mutant controls, certificate pin discipline, registered replay and a measured before/after median. Do not reopen the mathematical rejection or run the selected cold frontier replay.
evidence: PASS_INPLACE_SIDE_PREFIX_FAST via research/inplace-side-performance/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_IDENTICAL_INPLACE_PREFIX_RECEIPTS via benchmark.py; certificates/inplace-side.json differs from base only in the inplace_side.py source pin.
